page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.32xlarge is a general-purpose instance type built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated physical cores using the x86_64 architecture, powered by Intel Xeon 8369B processors operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. With a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, each vCPU maps directly to a dedicated physical core, eliminating resource contention associated with hyperthreading.

The instance is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers between instances and cloud services.

A key architectural tradeoff of the ecs.g7.32xlarge is the complete absence of local storage and dedicated GPU hardware. Storage requirements must be met entirely through network-attached block storage options. This design prioritizes high-density compute and memory resources over localized storage performance.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated core allocation and balanced resource density make this instance suitable for enterprise-grade workloads. It is designed for multi-threaded applications, large-scale web serving, enterprise applications, and distributed database nodes that require consistent CPU performance without the overhead of shared-core architectures.
